name: Grime Atlas
tagline: Run the whole filthy operation from one screen. Mop optional.
positioning: Grime Atlas is the job and crew platform for industrial cleaning shops — scheduling, quotes, and proof-of-clean for owner-operators who'd rather be scrubbing.

hero.h1: The mess is the business. This is the paperwork.
hero.sub: Grime Atlas runs quotes, crews, routes, and proof-of-clean for industrial cleaning shops — so you spend less time chasing invoices and more time chasing grease traps.

features.title: Quotes that don't take a Tuesday
features.description: Walk the floor, tap the surfaces, send a branded estimate before you've packed the pressure washer. Your crew rate does the math.

features.title: Crews where you left them
features.description: Drag jobs onto techs, watch clock-ins hit the map, and know who's on the third-shift warehouse without a single 'you there?' text.

features.title: Proof-of-clean, timestamped
features.description: Before-and-after photos, checklists, and site sign-off attach to the job automatically. Disputes end where the receipts begin.

features.title: Invoices that actually collect
features.description: Auto-send on completion, nudge the slow payers, and reconcile against the deposit — no spreadsheet named final_FINAL_v3.

features.title: Recurring routes on autopilot
features.description: Nightly floors, weekly kitchens, monthly ducts — set the cadence once and Grime Atlas rebuilds the schedule while you sleep.

features.title: Chemicals and gear, counted
features.description: Track degreaser by the drum and log SDS sheets per site, so the compliance binder writes itself before the audit does.

testimonials.quote: We used to lose two jobs a month to quotes I forgot to send. Now the estimate goes out before I've climbed off the scissor lift. Cleared 40 grand of ghost pipeline in a quarter.
testimonials.name: Dwayne Petro

testimonials.quote: My crews stopped texting me photos to a group chat that nobody could find at invoice time. Everything lives on the job now. The dispute emails just... stopped.
testimonials.name: Renata Voss

testimonials.quote: I bought it as a joke because the sign-up page insulted my spreadsheet. Then it saved my payroll math on a 22-person night shift. I'm not laughing anymore, but I did keep the mascot.
testimonials.name: Marcus Idle
